topic: 科技与日常工具 · Independent new scenario: choosing a digital tool for a specific user
grammarFocus: to do 表目的；动词后接 to do / doing 的常见用法；基础被动语态入门。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Choosing a Digital Tool for a Specific User
instructions: 这是一份原创的英语听力与语法练习材料，适合B1水平成人学习者。请先听或读对话，然后完成8道听力题。之后学习语法部分（表目的、动词后接to do/doing、基础被动语态），并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目均为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look busy. What are you doing?
Ben: I'm trying to choose a note-taking app for my dad. He's 65 and not good with technology.
Mia: OK. What does he need it for?
Ben: He wants to remember his medicines and doctor visits. He also needs to share lists with my mom.
Mia: So the app must be simple. Does he use a smartphone?
Ben: Yes, but he only uses it for calls and photos. He doesn't like small buttons.
Mia: Then a simple app with big text is better. Have you looked at 'EasyNote'?
Ben: Yes, I downloaded it yesterday. But it has too many ads. My dad gets confused by ads.
Mia: What about 'SimpleList'? It's designed for older users. It has no ads and the text is large.
Ben: That sounds good. Is it free?
Mia: The basic version is free. You pay for extra features, but your dad doesn't need them.
Ben: Can he share lists with my mom?
Mia: Yes, sharing is included in the free version. But you need to set it up for him first.
Ben: OK. I'll install it on his phone tonight. Thanks, Mia.
Mia: You're welcome. Remember to write a short guide for him.
Ben: Good idea. I'll do that.

questions.prompt: Who is Ben choosing an app for?
questions.explanation: Ben明确说“I'm trying to choose a note-taking app for my dad.”，所以是为他爸爸选应用。
questions.evidence: I'm trying to choose a note-taking app for my dad.

questions.prompt: What does Ben's dad want to remember?
questions.explanation: Ben说“He wants to remember his medicines and doctor visits.”，直接对应选项。
questions.evidence: He wants to remember his medicines and doctor visits.

questions.explanation: Ben说“But it has too many ads.”，因此他不喜欢EasyNote。
questions.evidence: But it has too many ads.

questions.explanation: Mia说“It's designed for older users.”，所以SimpleList是为老年用户设计的。

questions.prompt: Is the basic version of 'SimpleList' free?
questions.explanation: Mia说“The basic version is free.”，所以基础版是免费的。

questions.prompt: Can Ben's dad share lists with his mom in the free version?
questions.explanation: Mia说“sharing is included in the free version.”，所以免费版包含分享功能。
questions.evidence: sharing is included in the free version.

questions.prompt: What does Ben need to do first before his dad uses the app? (one word)
questions.explanation: Mia说“But you need to set it up for him first.”，所以Ben需要先设置。填空答案来自原文的“set”。
questions.evidence: But you need to set it up for him first.

questions.prompt: What does Mia remind Ben to write?
questions.explanation: Mia说“Remember to write a short guide for him.”，所以是写一个简短的指南。
questions.evidence: Remember to write a short guide for him.

grammar.title: 表目的、动词后接to do/doing、基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: 1. 表目的：用to do或for doing表示目的。例如：I use it to take notes. / It is used for taking notes. 2. 动词后接to do或doing：有些动词后接to do（如want, need, try, remember），有些后接doing（如enjoy, finish, mind），有些两者都可但意思不同（如stop to do 停下来去做，stop doing 停止做）。3. 基础被动语态：be + 过去分词，表示“被……”。例如：The app is designed for older users. / Lists can be shared.

questions.explanation: 表示目的用to do，所以选to take。

questions.prompt: He enjoys ______ music on his phone.

questions.explanation: 被动语态be + 过去分词，表示“被设计”，所以选is designed。
questions.evidence: 被动语态be + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: The lists ______ by my mom every day.
questions.explanation: 被动语态，lists是复数，所以用are checked。
questions.evidence: 被动语态be + 过去分词。

questions.explanation: remember to do表示记得去做某事，所以选to install。
questions.evidence: remember to do表示记得去做。

questions.prompt: I need ______ a guide for my dad.

questions.explanation: 表示目的也可用for doing，所以选for taking。

part3: Why do some older people find technology difficult?
What can companies do to make apps easier for everyone?
Do you think digital tools make life simpler or more complicated?
How might digital tools change in the future?

transfer.writing: Write a short message (about 80-100 words) to a friend recommending a simple app for their grandfather. Explain what the app is for, why it is easy to use, and how to set it up. Use 'to do' for purpose and one passive sentence.
